heroHeadline: Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia Send Brent Back Above $106 as Iran Hardens Hormuz Preconditions
heroSubtitle: Houthi missile and drone strikes on Saudi Aramco's Yanbu export hub Sep 24 reversed the Saudi pipeline-restart rally, spiking Brent to a $108 intraday high; roughly 80 countries demanded the strait's reopening at the UN, but Iran hardened rather than softened its stance Sep 25, tying a seven-day roadmap to the US acting first
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports (FAO, World Bank, IMF, IEA, WFP), major outlets (Reuters, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, CNBC), and institutional analyses (Lloyd's List, S&P Global, IFPRI, Atlantic Council).
